name: E-Stack Measurement Batch V1 - Smoke Test
description: Safe first validation of Measurement Batch on KICK and MID L. Exercises measurement-input routing, routing/mutes, delay, phase all-pass, crossover override, baseline rebuild and final restore. This is a functional test, not an optimisation campaign.

steps.name: KICK solo - attenuated
steps.instruction: Verify SOURCE is IN4 and only KICK is active. Run REW only if the level is safe.
steps.position: Keep the microphone fixed for the whole smoke test

rew.notes: Smoke test - REW physical IN4 - KICK solo, -15 dB relative to captured baseline

steps.name: MID L solo - attenuated
steps.instruction: Verify only MID L is active.

rew.notes: Smoke test - MID L solo, -15 dB relative to captured baseline

steps.name: KICK + MID L baseline - attenuated
steps.instruction: Verify KICK and MID L are active and all other ways are muted. No delay, phase or crossover test override is applied.

rew.notes: Smoke test - baseline processing rebuilt from session snapshot

steps.name: MID L delay +0.50 ms
steps.instruction: Check that MID L delay is exactly baseline +0.50 ms while KICK remains at its captured baseline delay.

rew.notes: Smoke test - MID L delay offset +0.50 ms

steps.name: MID L phase -45 deg at HPF
steps.instruction: Check that an E-Stack AllpassFO phase filter is applied to MID L and referenced to its current HPF.

rew.notes: Smoke test - MID L -45 degrees referenced to current HPF

steps.name: XO 275 Hz LR24 + MID phase -45 deg
steps.instruction: Check KICK LPF and MID L HPF are 275 Hz LR24. MID L phase must be recalculated as -45 degrees at the new 275 Hz HPF.

rew.notes: Smoke test - validates crossover-before-phase calculation order

steps.name: Return to captured processing - attenuated
steps.instruction: Before finishing, verify delay, phase and crossover test overrides have disappeared. Only the -15 dB smoke-test attenuation remains on KICK and MID L.

rew.notes: Smoke test - confirms each step is rebuilt from captured baseline rather than accumulated
